thread:
elaine (product): Quick sync — we need to lock streaming contract for chat/completions for Q2 roadmap. Customers have three asks: simple SSE for webhooks, resumable websocket for mobile, and explicit tool-call streaming for integrations. How tight should MVP be?

matt (eng-runtime): High level: one canonical stream shape is easiest to maintain. We could pick WS as primary and provide an SSE compatibility layer (server -> SSE proxy) to cover browsers. That avoids duplicating kernel logic.

sam (eng-ml): Agree single shape. Also we need to decide delta format: plain text fragments vs structured tokens with spans. Plain text is smallest surface but makes reconstructing structured outputs (JSON, function args) brittle.

katie (devex): SDK impact — consumers expect identical semantics across Node, Python, and mobile. If we pick WS-first + SSE shim, SDKs can normalize events. But we need clear finish_reason semantics for retries/resume.

julian (sales): From customers: some enterprises need resumability (mobile disconnects) and deterministic finish reasons for billing and safety audits. They also ask that tool calls stream partial tool outputs as they arrive.

matt (eng-runtime): Proposal for MVP (scope-light): streaming text deltas (field: delta.text), top-level event types: message.delta, message.finish (finish_reason: stop|length|error|cancel), and a tool-call event: tool.call_start / tool.call_data (streaming payload) / tool.call_end. Support WS natively, SSE shim for hosted. No resume for MVP.

sam (eng-ml): For quality we must emit token-level meta optionally (delta.tokens with token_ids) for debugging, but keep it opt-in. Also recommend finish_reason enums: stop, max_tokens, truncated (server-side dropped), error, user_cancel. 'length' is ambiguous.

katie (devex): Launch criteria checklist suggestion: 1) defined JSON event schema + examples, 2) Node/Python SDK emit same events, 3) docs + quickstart, 4) hosted SSE shim, 5) compatibility tests with existing non-streaming endpoints (same final output), 6) perf: 95th token latency under 120ms on p95 test workload.

julian (sales): Is resume going to be a separate enterprise-only feature? Call it out so I can set expectations.

matt (eng-runtime): Yes, resume (checkpointing + reconnect id) is not trivial — needs KV cache pointers and auth reuse. Strongly prefer to gate resume behind Dedicated/Private for now. That keeps hosted MVP manageable.

sam (eng-ml): Also call out structured outputs: for function calling we should stream an explicit 'function_call' object with name/args fragments to avoid clients trying to parse text. That's crucial if customers plan to do incremental function arg parsing.

elaine (product): So agreed MVP scope: WS primary + SSE shim, text-delta events, explicit finish_reason enum (use sam's wording), tool-call streaming events, no resume. Launch criteria as katie listed. Anything missing?

katie (devex): Add: migration guide — how to move from sync completions to streaming (examples for chat UIs and server-side pipelines).

julian (sales): Add an FAQ entry about billing: how partial streams count towards tokens. Customers will ask.

matt (eng-runtime): Implementation note: we should version the stream contract (stream_v1) and include a handshake event with model, sequence_id, and schema_version. That makes future v2 resume/structured changes safer.

sam (eng-ml): One more: define client behavior on finish_reason=truncated vs max_tokens so users know whether to retry with higher max_tokens or accept truncation. Put guidance in docs.

elaine (product): Ok: action items — matt to draft event schema + handshake by EOD Fri, katie to scope SDK adapter changes, sam to define finish_reason enums and structured function_call shape, julian to gather top 3 customer resumability asks by next Wed. I'll consolidate for roadmap PR. :thumbsup:

stream-bot: deploy queued: branch/streaming-contract-spec -> staging (CI)

matt (eng-runtime): noted. Will include example curl for SSE shim and minimal WS client snippet.

elaine (product): Thanks — meeting to lock rollout gating next Tue 10am. If anyone objects to the MVP scope call it out here.

katie (devex): No objections from SDK side.

sam (eng-ml): No objections.

julian (sales): Fine with gating resume to enterprise.

matt (eng-runtime): No objections. Will start spec PR.
